title: スプリンターズSの後に・オー！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After suffering a staggering defeat before Nishino Flower's sheer speed, Sakura Bakushin O is left in a stupor from the unforeseen turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fearful that Nishino Flower will eventually come to usurp her title as class representative, she is determined to win at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O makes a formal challenge to Nishino Flower, asking her to scrub her neck and wait. I suppose she wants her rival's neck to be clean when she comes for it…
